name: constellation
description: Constellation: the idea map as a Desk mod. Offers to map an idea on the board, to summarize the session, and to turn a repeated step into an automation, through the local Constellation MCP server.

offers.title: Map this on the board
offers.summary: Lay the ideas in play out as stars and beams on the Constellation map of the active session, so the options and their links are visible side by side.
offers.restraint: Not for a single linear task, a quick fix or a yes/no question; only when several ideas or options are on the table.

offers.title: Write the session summary
offers.summary: Read the session outline, then save a short written summary of what changed and what was decided to the Constellation session.
offers.restraint: Only at a natural stopping point with real progress; not mid-task and not twice in one stretch of work.

offers.title: Turn this into an automation
offers.summary: Save the step just done by hand as a Constellation automation (a schedule, a map event or a manual trigger), checking the list first so it updates instead of duplicating.
offers.restraint: Only for a step the user has repeated or asked to repeat; never a one-off, and never anything that spends money or posts publicly unasked.
